                     HYPHENATE AND PAGINATE DOCUMENT

                                       YOUR     POSSIBLE
  ID  ITEM                             CHOICE   CHOICES

  a   Dictionary Hyphenation             1      1 = Prompted 2 = Automatic
                                                3 = None
  b   Paginate, Hyphenate, Spell
      Check from Page                    1      1 - 2
  c   Paginate On Exact Line Count       2      1 = Yes      2 = No
  d   Print Paginated Pages              1      1 = Yes      2 = No
  e   Paper Handling                     1      1 = Cut Paper,Manual Feed
                                                2 = Cut Paper,Automatic Feed
                                                3 = Continuous Paper




When finished with this menu, press ENTER.
